output: Proposed the exact one-outcome terminal-congestion predicate on the same handoff pattern P: each demand-terminal fibre has size at most three and P admits an edge-to-terminal map with fibres at most three. Finite counting then gives |P| ≤ 3|T| and |T| ≥ ceil((Q_geom+1)/3). The full matching/star demand count and Q_geom≥2 exclude T={rho}, so at least one declared route ends away from the root. This remains a candidate terminal restriction, with no route-edge, envelope, cap, or near-cubic payoff claimed.
